title: IIM Calcutta launches 9-month AI-powered product management course for working professionals
summary: IIM Calcutta launches a nine-month AI-powered product management certification program for working professionals
detailed: IIM Calcutta launched a nine-month AI-powered product management programme for working professionals in partnership with TimesPro.
Applicants are required to have a recognized graduate degree or diploma and at least three years of professional experience.
The curriculum spans 12 modules covering product strategy, customer intelligence, AI-driven decision-making, and includes a capstone project and two campus immersions.
Participants will be evaluated through written assessments, online exams, and project work to receive a certificate of completion.

The Indian Institute of Management Calcutta (IIM Calcutta) has launched a nine-month Artificial Intelligence (AI)- powered product management programme for working professionals.
The course integrates AI-driven product strategy, customer intelligence and product leadership with applied learning and campus immersions.
Individuals with at least three years of professional experience and hold a recognised graduate degree or diploma (10+2+3) in any discipline are eligible to join the course.
International applicants must hold a graduate degree or equivalent qualification from a recognised institution in their respective country to be eligible for the programme at IIM Calcutta.
The nine-month course covers product strategy, customer-centric innovation, AI-enabled decision-making and product-led growth.
The course has been launched in partnership with TimesPro and integrates AI-driven product strategy, customer intelligence and product leadership with applied learning and campus immersions.

Prashant Mishra and Soumyakanti Chakraborty, programme directors, IIM Calcutta said: “AI can tell a product team far more about what customers do, but it cannot decide which problems deserve attention.
That calls for judgement, commercial understanding and an ability to challenge the evidence.
Participants will undertake a capstone project that draws together concepts from across the curriculum and applies them to practical product management challenges.
The programme also includes two campus immersions of two days each at IIM Calcutta.

IIM Calcutta faculty will conduct live online sessions through TimesPro’s interactive learning platform, combining academic instruction with case discussions, real-world business scenarios, interactive simulations, projects and applied learning exercises.
Campus immersions will complement the online learning experience through in-person academic engagement.
The management institute will evaluate participants through written assessments, online examinations and project work.
Participants who successfully fulfil the programme requirements will receive a certificate of completion from IIM Calcutta.
